metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for explicit executor lifecycle management (shutdown, resource release, cancellation control). Peer candidates address initialization and context manager patterns, which are complementary but separate capabilities. No existing skill in the registry matches this semantic identity (executor shutdown lifecycle). The three peer candidates cover initialization and automatic cleanup via context managers, but not explicit manual shutdown with granular control over wait and cancel_futures parameters. This is a new, non-overlapping capability.
